purpose: Overlapping avatars for the people in a project or conversation, with +n for the rest.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the group, for example Project members

whenToUse: To show who is involved without listing everyone
whenNotToUse: When each person needs an action — use List
antiPatterns: Showing more than about six avatars

anatomy: Avatars overlapping by a quarter, each with a 2px surface edge, and a +n square

a11yNotes: A group named by the label; each avatar is named; +n is named, for example 2 more
